## Abstract
The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks. This work proposes the Transformer, an architecture relying entirely on attention mechanisms and dispensing with recurrence and convolutions. The model is more parallelizable, requires significantly less training time, and achieves state-of-the-art results on machine translation benchmarks.
